title: Average and Heterogeneous Associations between Secondhand Smoking and Tooth Loss
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Volume 105, Issue 12, Page 1555-1563, November 2026.
Secondhand smoke (SHS) is a pervasive health concern increasingly associated with tooth loss, yet studies assessing its population-level associations and potential heterogeneity are limited. This study aimed at estimating the average and subgroup-specific ...
